(i) the proposed learning to search approach outperforms the state of the art in machine translation, and (ii) the proposed semiring and training objective outperform the previous state of the art, and (iii) the proposed exploration approach outperforms previous exploration approaches.

(1) the new training objective is effective in improving the quality of translations; (2) the parsing coordinator architecture is more efficient than the standard beam search; (3) the semiring can be applied to a variety of SMT models and is effective in improving translation accuracy; and (4) the exploration method is effective at improving translation quality.
